content:
maya_peopleops: quick post-all-hands follow-up with clear answers to the most asked promo/comp questions. keeping it short so managers can copy/paste.
rachel_total_rewards: TL;DR bullets up front: 1) retro pays to effective date if approvals hit payroll cutoff; 2) promos can be effective during leave; 3) existing RSU schedules don't change automatically. details below.
dan_engineering_manager: can you confirm who signs if the manager leaves mid-process?
maya_peopleops: short answer: skip-level or director. if neither is available, People Ops signs to avoid blocking payroll—document the signer in the packet.

maya_peopleops: Retro pay rules
- Retro is calculated back to the stated effective date (not the approval timestamp).
- Payroll cutoff: if packet fully approved before payroll cutoff, retro lands in the next pay run. if missed, it's in the following pay run (expect ~1-pay-period lag).
- Pro tip: mark "RETRO REQUESTED" in the packet subject line to speed triage.

rachel_total_rewards: Bonus & proration
- Bonus eligibility follows the payout calculation date. If the effective date is before that date, the new band applies; otherwise, the prior band does.
- Proration: bonuses are prorated by days in band during the performance window. Reach out to total-rewards for complex cases.

maya_peopleops: Promotions during leave
- Promotions are allowed while someone is on parental or medical leave if there is sufficient performance evidence and manager recommendation. Calibration may request extra context; don't assume an automatic pause.

rachel_total_rewards: Equity note
- Existing RSUs keep their same vest schedule. Promotion doesn't retroactively change prior grants. Any new grant approvals will be separate.

maya_peopleops: Manager packet checklist (copyable)
- Employee name + current & proposed title/band
- Effective date (YYYY-MM-DD) + "RETRO REQUESTED" if applicable
- 2-3 concise impact bullets (metrics or outcomes)
- Proposed comp (base + bonus target) and justification
- Signer name (skip-level/director if manager unavailable)
- Links to supporting artifacts (PRs, customer notes, dashboards)

dan_engineering_manager: can we get a one-liner for 1:1s?
maya_peopleops: short script: "Congrats <name> 96 we're promoting you to <new title> effective <date>. This reflects your impact on <metric/project>. People Ops will follow up with paperwork and payroll timing. Let me know any questions."

hr-bot: Promo packet template v5 uploaded: https://drive.google.com/example-promo-v5 (auto note)

maya_peopleops: next steps: i'll publish a slim one-pager in #managers with the checklist, scripts, and links by EOD. scheduling two 20-min drop-in sessions for packet reviews next week. drop edge cases here and we'll triage.
lucy_ceo: thanks team 96 appreciate the clarity and fast follow-up. :clap:
